decks.module: Control mountain descents and animal encounters

cards.front: Complete the rule: The handbook identifies Idaho's traveler service as a.
cards.back: The handbook identifies Idaho's traveler service as a source for closures, roadwork, tourism, incidents, delays and weather-related road conditions.
cards.memory_hook: Control mountain descents and animal encounters

cards.front: Complete the rule: In mountains, heed speed controls and warnings.
cards.back: In mountains, heed speed controls and warnings about curves, steep grades and other hazards.
cards.memory_hook: Control mountain descents and animal encounters

cards.front: Complete the rule: On mountain roads, stay near the right.
cards.back: On mountain roads, stay near the right edge to leave space from opposing traffic.
cards.memory_hook: Control mountain descents and animal encounters

cards.front: Complete the rule: Use a lower gear to control.
cards.back: Use a lower gear to control speed on a long downhill grade.
cards.memory_hook: Control mountain descents and animal encounters

cards.front: Complete the rule: Do not coast downhill in.
cards.back: Do not coast downhill in Neutral or with the clutch disengaged.
cards.memory_hook: Control mountain descents and animal encounters

cards.front: Complete the rule: Watch for a solid yellow line in.
cards.back: Watch for a solid yellow line in the lane indicating a mountain-road no-passing area.
cards.memory_hook: Control mountain descents and animal encounters

cards.front: Complete the rule: Sound the horn before a curve on.
cards.back: Sound the horn before a curve on a narrow road when the view is obstructed.
cards.memory_hook: Control mountain descents and animal encounters

cards.front: Complete the rule: Do not swerve around a small.
cards.back: Do not swerve around a small animal unless certain the maneuver is safe.
cards.memory_hook: Control mountain descents and animal encounters

cards.front: Complete the rule: For a large animal on or near the.
cards.back: For a large animal on or near the road, slow and proceed cautiously because more herd animals may be nearby.
cards.memory_hook: Control mountain descents and animal encounters

cards.front: Complete the rule: If an animal enters too quickly to avoid.
cards.back: If an animal enters too quickly to avoid safely, consider maintaining control through an impact as the safer alternative.
cards.memory_hook: Control mountain descents and animal encounters

cards.front: Complete the rule: Livestock being moved under control across.
cards.back: Livestock being moved under control across a road have priority in Idaho.
cards.memory_hook: Control mountain descents and animal encounters

cards.front: Complete the rule: When meeting or passing a livestock herd.
cards.back: When meeting or passing a livestock herd, proceed carefully and cooperate with its handlers.
cards.memory_hook: Control mountain descents and animal encounters

cards.front: Complete the rule: The handbook describes open range as nearly all.
cards.back: The handbook describes open range as nearly all land outside city limits and herd districts where livestock customarily or by authorized grazing may roam.
cards.memory_hook: Control mountain descents and animal encounters

cards.front: Complete the rule: Fences do not establish that livestock are absent.
cards.back: Fences do not establish that livestock are absent or lack priority; use extra caution in open-range areas at night.
cards.memory_hook: Control mountain descents and animal encounters

cards.front: Complete the rule: Under the handbook's stated open-range or controlled-herd collision.
cards.back: Under the handbook's stated open-range or controlled-herd collision rule, an injured or killed animal's owner is not liable for the driver's vehicle damage, and a negligent driver may be liable for the animal.
cards.memory_hook: Control mountain descents and animal encounters

decks.module: Adapt visibility and following space at night

cards.front: Complete the rule: At night, keep speed low enough to.
cards.back: At night, keep speed low enough to stop within the road distance actually visible ahead.
cards.memory_hook: Adapt visibility and following space at

cards.front: Complete the rule: Increase the following.
cards.back: Increase the following gap at night.
cards.memory_hook: Adapt visibility and following space at

cards.front: Complete the rule: Use headlights rather than parking lights between sunset.
cards.back: Use headlights rather than parking lights between sunset and sunrise or when visibility falls below five hundred feet.
cards.memory_hook: Adapt visibility and following space at

cards.front: Complete the rule: At night, watch for unlit or.
cards.back: At night, watch for unlit or slow vehicles, cyclists, pedestrians and animals.
cards.memory_hook: Adapt visibility and following space at

cards.front: Complete the rule: Allow additional time and.
cards.back: Allow additional time and distance when passing at night.
cards.memory_hook: Adapt visibility and following space at

cards.front: Complete the rule: Do not begin or continue night driving while.
cards.back: Do not begin or continue night driving while tired, and do not wear sunglasses in low light.
cards.memory_hook: Adapt visibility and following space at

cards.front: Complete the rule: Keep both sides of the windshield clean and.
cards.back: Keep both sides of the windshield clean and remove headlight dirt that can weaken or distort the beam.
cards.memory_hook: Adapt visibility and following space at

cards.front: Complete the rule: Avoid staring into approaching headlights; direct the eyes.
cards.back: Avoid staring into approaching headlights; direct the eyes toward the lower right of the driving lane.
cards.memory_hook: Adapt visibility and following space at

cards.front: Complete the rule: Select low beams when approaching or following.
cards.back: Select low beams when approaching or following another vehicle or traveling on a lighted road.
cards.memory_hook: Adapt visibility and following space at

cards.front: Complete the rule: If night parking on a highway shoulder.
cards.back: If night parking on a highway shoulder is necessary, use emergency flashers or parking lights.
cards.memory_hook: Adapt visibility and following space at

cards.front: Complete the rule: Keep extra caution around snow-removal equipment because thrown.
cards.back: Keep extra caution around snow-removal equipment because thrown snow can severely restrict a close follower's visibility.
cards.memory_hook: Adapt visibility and following space at

decks.module: Work safely around snowplows and low visibility

cards.front: Complete the rule: The winter-driving guidance recommends staying two car lengths.
cards.back: The winter-driving guidance recommends staying two car lengths behind a snowplow for each ten miles an hour of speed.
cards.memory_hook: Work safely around snowplows and low

cards.front: Complete the rule: Pass a snowplow only when absolutely necessary and.
cards.back: Pass a snowplow only when absolutely necessary and when the road ahead is clearly visible; do not pass on the snow-spraying side.
cards.memory_hook: Work safely around snowplows and low

cards.front: Complete the rule: Do not merge back immediately ahead of a.
cards.back: Do not merge back immediately ahead of a snowplow because its blades may be hidden by snow.
cards.memory_hook: Work safely around snowplows and low

cards.front: Complete the rule: Avoid abrupt braking ahead of a snowplow because.
cards.back: Avoid abrupt braking ahead of a snowplow because the heavy vehicle cannot stop as quickly as a car.
cards.memory_hook: Work safely around snowplows and low

cards.front: Complete the rule: Abandon a car during snow clearing only if.
cards.back: Abandon a car during snow clearing only if absolutely necessary, leaving it as far off the road as possible.
cards.memory_hook: Work safely around snowplows and low

cards.front: Complete the rule: Low beams are best in reduced daytime visibility.
cards.back: Low beams are best in reduced daytime visibility; check that the lights are set low when first switching them on.
cards.memory_hook: Work safely around snowplows and low

cards.front: Complete the rule: Avoid driving in fog, dust storms or heavy.
cards.back: Avoid driving in fog, dust storms or heavy rain if possible; if driving is necessary, reduce speed.
cards.memory_hook: Work safely around snowplows and low

cards.front: Complete the rule: Do not use cruise control.
cards.back: Do not use cruise control on a wet or icy road.
cards.memory_hook: Work safely around snowplows and low

cards.front: Complete the rule: Slow further when red taillights appear in poor.
cards.back: Slow further when red taillights appear in poor visibility because the vehicle ahead may be stopped or moving very slowly.
cards.memory_hook: Work safely around snowplows and low

decks.module: Respond to rain, hydroplaning and flood danger

cards.front: Complete the rule: If visibility conditions become too severe, leave the.
cards.back: If visibility conditions become too severe, leave the roadway and stop rather than creeping along where another vehicle may strike from behind.
cards.memory_hook: Respond to rain hydroplaning and flood

cards.front: Complete the rule: Avoid using emergency flashers while moving in poor.
cards.back: Avoid using emergency flashers while moving in poor conditions because another driver may mistake the vehicle for stopped.
cards.memory_hook: Respond to rain hydroplaning and flood

cards.front: Complete the rule: Reduce speed in wet weather because stopping takes.
cards.back: Reduce speed in wet weather because stopping takes more distance and quick turns can cause a skid.
cards.memory_hook: Respond to rain hydroplaning and flood

cards.front: Complete the rule: A light rain's beginning can be especially.
cards.back: A light rain's beginning can be especially slippery when water mixes with road oil.
cards.memory_hook: Respond to rain hydroplaning and flood

cards.front: Complete the rule: Hydroplaning means the tires ride on a water.
cards.back: Hydroplaning means the tires ride on a water film and can lose roadway contact and control for braking, acceleration or steering.
cards.memory_hook: Respond to rain hydroplaning and flood

cards.front: Complete the rule: To reduce hydroplaning risk, slow for rain, slush.
cards.back: To reduce hydroplaning risk, slow for rain, slush and standing water, replace worn tires and keep inflation correct.
cards.memory_hook: Respond to rain hydroplaning and flood

cards.front: Complete the rule: If entering a slippery area or beginning to.
cards.back: If entering a slippery area or beginning to hydroplane, keep a straight course and gently release the accelerator.
cards.memory_hook: Respond to rain hydroplaning and flood

cards.front: Complete the rule: Do not attempt an abrupt turn or stop.
cards.back: Do not attempt an abrupt turn or stop while hydroplaning; wait for tire grip to return.
cards.memory_hook: Respond to rain hydroplaning and flood

cards.front: Complete the rule: If braking is necessary in the described slippery-area.
cards.back: If braking is necessary in the described slippery-area situation, the handbook advises gentle pumping for vehicles without ABS.
cards.memory_hook: Respond to rain hydroplaning and flood

cards.front: Complete the rule: Take immediate protective action after a Flash Flood.
cards.back: Take immediate protective action after a Flash Flood Warning or when water is visibly rising fast.
cards.memory_hook: Respond to rain hydroplaning and flood

cards.front: Complete the rule: Do not drive across a flooded.
cards.back: Do not drive across a flooded road; turn back and select another route.
cards.memory_hook: Respond to rain hydroplaning and flood

cards.front: Complete the rule: Leave flood-prone dips, low areas, canyons, dry creek.
cards.back: Leave flood-prone dips, low areas, canyons, dry creek beds and stream corridors for higher, safer ground.
cards.memory_hook: Respond to rain hydroplaning and flood

cards.front: Complete the rule: Avoid river, stream and already-flooded areas because an.
cards.back: Avoid river, stream and already-flooded areas because an underwater road may have been damaged or washed away.
cards.memory_hook: Respond to rain hydroplaning and flood

cards.front: Complete the rule: If a vehicle stalls during the flood situation.
cards.back: If a vehicle stalls during the flood situation, leave it promptly and move to higher ground before rising water can sweep it away.
cards.memory_hook: Respond to rain hydroplaning and flood

cards.front: Complete the rule: Use added care at night when.
cards.back: Use added care at night when flooding hazards are harder to see.
cards.memory_hook: Respond to rain hydroplaning and flood

cards.front: Complete the rule: During threatening flood conditions, do not camp or.
cards.back: During threatening flood conditions, do not camp or park beside a stream or dry stream bed.
cards.memory_hook: Respond to rain hydroplaning and flood

cards.front: Complete the rule: The handbook warns that as little as six.
cards.back: The handbook warns that as little as six inches of fast-flowing water can knock a person down, and two feet can carry away a vehicle.
cards.memory_hook: Respond to rain hydroplaning and flood

decks.module: Use winter control and equipment guidance

cards.front: Complete the rule: On icy or snowy roads, drive slower, turn.
cards.back: On icy or snowy roads, drive slower, turn and stop gently and allow a longer following gap.
cards.memory_hook: Use winter control and equipment guidance

cards.front: Complete the rule: Prepare lights, tires, brakes, wipers.
cards.back: Prepare lights, tires, brakes, wipers, defroster and radiator for winter use.
cards.memory_hook: Use winter control and equipment guidance

cards.front: Complete the rule: Before even a short winter drive, clean and.
cards.back: Before even a short winter drive, clean and defrost the windows; keep the washer filled with nonfreezing fluid.
cards.memory_hook: Use winter control and equipment guidance

cards.front: Complete the rule: Use the vehicle's fitted safety belts.
cards.back: Use the vehicle's fitted safety belts and shoulder restraints during winter travel.
cards.memory_hook: Use winter control and equipment guidance

cards.front: Complete the rule: Start slowly to test steering and braking on.
cards.back: Start slowly to test steering and braking on winter roads, and press the accelerator gently to avoid wheelspin.
cards.memory_hook: Use winter control and equipment guidance

cards.front: Complete the rule: The winter guidance says to begin slowing for.
cards.back: The winter guidance says to begin slowing for a turn or stop at least three times sooner than usual.
cards.memory_hook: Use winter control and equipment guidance

cards.front: Complete the rule: When stopping on slick winter roads, avoid sudden.
cards.back: When stopping on slick winter roads, avoid sudden steering; consult the owner's manual, using gentle brake pumping for non-ABS vehicles and steady pressure when appropriate for ABS.
cards.memory_hook: Use winter control and equipment guidance

cards.front: Complete the rule: The handbook recommends tire chains for very slippery.
cards.back: The handbook recommends tire chains for very slippery roads and checking other states' winter chain rules before traveling there.
cards.memory_hook: Use winter control and equipment guidance

cards.front: Complete the rule: Watch for ice in shade and on bridges.
cards.back: Watch for ice in shade and on bridges or overpasses, where it may form earlier or persist longer.
cards.memory_hook: Use winter control and equipment guidance

cards.front: Complete the rule: The handbook's usual studded-snow-tire interval is October first.
cards.back: The handbook's usual studded-snow-tire interval is October first through April thirtieth, with possible department changes for weather.
cards.memory_hook: Use winter control and equipment guidance

cards.front: Complete the rule: Carry a winter emergency kit in case.
cards.back: Carry a winter emergency kit in case a breakdown or crash strands the vehicle.
cards.memory_hook: Prepare for winter stranding

cards.front: Complete the rule: The kit list includes a flashlight and spare.
cards.back: The kit list includes a flashlight and spare batteries, first-aid supplies, a pocket knife and at least one blanket or sleeping bag.
cards.memory_hook: Prepare for winter stranding

cards.front: Complete the rule: Pack extra gloves, socks, a wool cap, traction.
cards.back: Pack extra gloves, socks, a wool cap, traction sand or cat litter and a small shovel for winter stranding.
cards.memory_hook: Prepare for winter stranding

cards.front: Complete the rule: Include water, booster cables, emergency flares, nonperishable food.
cards.back: Include water, booster cables, emergency flares, nonperishable food, a bright attention cloth, waterproof matches or a lighter, a local map and a phone charger.
cards.memory_hook: Prepare for winter stranding

cards.front: Complete the rule: Before running the engine for heat while stranded.
cards.back: Before running the engine for heat while stranded, ensure snow does not block the exhaust pipe.
cards.memory_hook: Prepare for winter stranding

cards.front: Complete the rule: If available, attach a bright scarf or cloth.
cards.back: If available, attach a bright scarf or cloth to the antenna so snow crews can spot the stranded car.
cards.memory_hook: Prepare for winter stranding
